dataset_name: IBM AML Stateful Behavioral Feature Dataset
original_data_source: IBM Synthetic Anti-Money Laundering Dataset (HI-Small_Trans.csv & LI-Small_Trans.csv)
state_management: Stateful AccountState tracking strictly historical transactions (Welford's algorithm)
leakage_prevention: Features computed from pre-transaction state, updated after transaction feature generation

features.name: spending_deviation_score
features.description: Z-score of transaction amount relative to sender account's historical spending mean & standard deviation (Welford algorithm)

features.name: is_weekend
features.description: Binary indicator for weekend transactions (1 if Saturday/Sunday, else 0)

features.name: time_since_last_transaction
features.description: Elapsed seconds since account's previous transaction (0.0 for first transaction)

features.name: velocity_score
features.description: Historical cumulative count of prior transactions executed by sender account

features.name: is_first_transaction
features.description: Binary flag indicating if this is sender account's first observed transaction (1 if first, else 0)

features.name: is_new_receiver
features.description: Binary flag indicating if beneficiary receiver account is seen for the first time by sender (1 if new, else 0)

features.name: is_new_bank
features.description: Binary flag indicating if beneficiary bank ID has never been transferred to previously by sender (1 if new, else 0)

features.name: is_new_payment_format
features.description: Binary flag indicating if payment format/channel is new for this sender account (1 if new, else 0)

features.name: is_cross_bank_transfer
features.description: Binary indicator showing if sender bank differs from receiver bank (1 if inter-bank, else 0)

features.name: is_cross_currency_transfer
features.description: Binary indicator showing if payment currency differs from receiving currency (1 if FX transfer, else 0)

features.name: payment_channel
features.description: Categorical payment format/channel used (e.g. ACH, Wire, Credit Card, Cheque)

features.name: is_fraud
features.description: Binary ground-truth target label (1 = Laundering / Fraud, 0 = Legitimate)
